caseName: Alabama Department of Corrections v. Glover
caseNameFull: Alabama Department of Corrections v. Glover

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Kentucky v. Graham, 478 U. S. 159 (1985).
